title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT 2+1+2 LUX TEK SECRET GARDEN!
description_sq:
Ne rezidencen Secret Garden, prane qendres tregtare Teg, ofrohet per shitje ky apartament luksoz.
Rezidenca pozicionohet mes gjelberimit dhe ajrit te paster, me siguri 24h dhe komunitet te zgjedhur.
Apartamenti ofron nje pamje panoramike dhe ndricim natyral te mrekullueshem gjate gjithe dites. I arreduar me nje stil elegant/mondern, dhe kombinim ngjyrash te ngrohta, do ta gjeni veten ne oazin tuaj te qetesise dhe komoditetit maksimal.
Apartamenti ndodhet në një objekt tre katësh, me siperfaqe totale prej 220 m2 organizohet në:
- 1 sallon ndenje 
- 1 ambjent gatimi te vecuar nga salloni 
- 2 tualete 
- 2 dhoma gjumi 
- 1 depo 
Ne apartament jane kryer investime extra dhe shume cilesore qe i rezistojn kohes
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone jeni te lutur te kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 LUX AT SECRET GARDEN!
description_en: In the Secret Garden residence, near the Teg shopping center, this luxury apartment is offered for sale. The residence is positioned between greenery and clean air, with 24h security and a select community. The apartment offers a panoramic view and wonderful natural lighting throughout the day. Furnished with an elegant/modern style, and a combination of warm colors, you will find yourself in your oasis of calm and maximum comfort. The apartment is located in a three-story building, with a total area of ​​220 m2, it is organized in: - 1 living room - 1 kitchen area separate from the living room - 2 toilets - 2 bedrooms - 1 storage room Extra and very high-quality investments have been made in the apartment that stand the test of time. For more information or a visit to the property, please contact us.
